```artifact
Feature: Hospital Staff Information Acquisition and Feedback

  Scenario Outline: Hospital Staff identifies patient, chemist, and lab information

    Given the hospital staff has access to patient records
    When they review patient information
    Then they identify patient details

    Given the hospital staff has access to chemist records
    When they review chemist information
    Then they identify chemist details

    Given the hospital staff has access to lab records
    When they review lab information
    Then they identify lab details

  Examples:
    | Patient Information | Chemist Information | Lab Information |
    | John Doe, 35, Male | Jane Smith, 28, Female | Lab A, Blood Test |
    | Jane Doe, 29, Female | John Smith, 40, Male | Lab B, Urine Test |
    | Invalid Data | Invalid Data | Invalid Data |


Feature: Hospital Staff Requirements Statement

  Scenario Outline: Hospital Staff states software requirements

    Given the hospital staff is aware of the software
    When they discuss software requirements
    Then they state requirements clearly

    Given the hospital staff is aware of the software
    When they discuss software requirements
    Then they provide feedback for improvement

    Given the hospital staff is aware of the software
    When they discuss software requirements
    Then they provide feedback for modification

  Examples:
    | Software Requirements | Feedback |
    | Patient data tracking | Improve data accuracy |
    | Chemist data tracking | Improve data accuracy |
    | Lab data tracking | Improve data accuracy |
    | Invalid Requirements | Invalid Requirements | Invalid Requirements |


Feature: Project Management and Development Team Reference Document

  Scenario Outline: Project Management and Development team uses the document as a reference

    Given the project management team has the document
    When they review the document
    Then they understand project requirements
    Given the development team has the document
    When they review the document
    Then they understand development requirements

  Examples:
    | Project Requirements | Understanding |
    | Patient data tracking | Clear |
    | Chemist data tracking | Clear |
    | Lab data tracking | Clear |
    | Invalid Requirements | Unclear |


Feature: Project Management and Development Team Analysis, Design, and Implementation

  Scenario Outline: Project Management and Development team analyzes, designs, and implements the system

    Given the project management team has the document
    When they review the document
    Then they analyze requirements
    Given the development team has the document
    When they review the document
    Then they design the system
    Given the development team has the document
    When they review the document
    Then they implement the system

  Examples:
    | Analysis | Design | Implementation |
    | Requirements review | System design | System implementation |
    | Clear requirements | Clear design | Clear implementation |
    | Unclear requirements | Unclear design | Unclear implementation |

```
